summary: Trabajo sin internet para cualquier producto: detección de conexión con histéresis, tabla de qué funciona sin red (fuente única de verdad para pantallas y textos comerciales), bandeja de salida con idempotencia y revalidación al reconectar, y veredicto de frescura para datos guardados.
externalIo: none (the host probes the network, stores the outbox and sends the items)
invariants: Imports nothing; never reads the clock, the network or the disk: time and probe results are inputs.
Connectivity changes state only after N consecutive results (no flapping on a single failure).
A capability is reported as working offline only if it needs nothing/device, or its declared local resource is present.
Outbox items carry an idempotency key; order of sending is the order of creation.
Reconnect revalidation: sensitive items and items older than reviewAfterMs are never sent automatically; they move to needs_review until a person decides.
Non-retryable rejections stop at `failed`; retryable ones back off exponentially and end in needs_review after maxAttempts.
All functions return new objects; nothing is mutated.
api: initialConnectivity · recordProbe · evaluateCapabilities · offlineSummary · enqueue · revalidate · dueItems · settle · decide · outboxCounts · freshness
plannedMounts: Infinity Business Assistant (IBA): panel del dueño y del equipo
reuseNotes: Declare your product's capabilities as data (CapabilitySpec[]) and render evaluateCapabilities(); use the same list for marketing copy so nothing is promised that the list does not back. Persist OutboxItem objects anywhere; call revalidate() once when the connection returns, then dueItems()/settle() in a loop.
knownLimits: It does not resolve data conflicts between devices: the destination must be idempotent and reject stale changes.
It cannot make cloud-only services (AI in the cloud, telephony, messaging) work without a connection; it only tells the truth about them.
Probing strategy (what to ping, how often) is the host's decision.
